metadata.name: Executive Grounds
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A look-alike of the White House and its grounds: the mansion with its North Portico and the curved South Portico and balcony, the State rooms and the Residence upstairs, the West Wing with its oval office, cabinet room and press briefing room over the situation room in the basement, the East Wing, the Rose Garden, the South Lawn with its fountain and two helipads (a dropship and a gunship parked), fences, gates and guard booths, and the ornate executive office building across West Executive Avenue with a sniper's roof. Intruders come in from Pennsylvania Avenue and the Ellipse; Security holds the house. Bomb sites in the oval office and the situation room; four hostages upstairs in the Residence.
